stories.headline: FAO says over 60% of Pakistanis cannot afford a healthy diet
stories.summary: FAO's assessment on Food Supply for Healthy Diets in Pakistan said over 60% of Pakistanis cannot afford a healthy diet and called for transformation of the agrifood system.
stories.why_it_matters: Affordability of nutritious food connects food security, public health, poverty and agricultural policy.

quick_gk.label: Pakistanis unable to afford a healthy diet

institutions: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
reports: Food Supply for Healthy Diets in Pakistan

sources.title: FAO flags gaps in Pakistan’s nutritious food supply

stories.headline: Pakistan calls at UN for self-determination for Kashmiris and Palestinians
stories.summary: Pakistan reiterated at the United Nations that the right of self-determination should be guaranteed to Kashmiris and Palestinians and argued for consistent application of international law.
stories.why_it_matters: The statement reflects Pakistan's continuing diplomatic positions on Kashmir, Palestine and international law.

sources.title: Pakistan calls on UN to guarantee right of self-determination to Kashmiris, Palestinians

stories.headline: OpenAI CEO argues AI benefits justify accepting some risks
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman argued for broad public access to AI and a lighter-touch regulatory approach while acknowledging risks, highlighting a widening industry debate over frontier-AI governance.
stories.why_it_matters: The debate is relevant to global AI regulation, cybersecurity and governance of increasingly capable systems.

sources.title: OpenAI's Altman says AI benefits warrant accepting some risks
